summary.text: Larry Liston, a Republican, represents District 10 (El Paso County) in the Colorado State Senate.

paragraphs.text: He has held the seat since January 2021; he previously served in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 16) from 2005 to 2013 and from 2017 to 2021.
He lives in Colorado Springs and earned a B.S. in business administration from Colorado State University in 1975.
His career experience includes working as an investment executive.
